about_the_game:
Try to survive in a dystopian future version of Europe that has been devastated by a global energy crisis. Embark on dangerous missions, gather essential resources, and expand your camp to rediscover your place in this broken world.

Use cards to defeat enemies



Decide which cards you want to play. Different playstyles work against different enemies, so be careful what cards you choose!

Play the missions Cologne and Berlin



Get insights what the world of Kind Nature is all about and fight through a destroyed Europe while trying to get new resouces for your camp.

Lots of different Cards



Collect different attack, support or defense cards for your deck. Improve your character with powerful equipment cards or get stronger cards faster by upgrading your deck with better Runner cards.

A fresh take on the deckbuilding genre

In Kind Nature, deckbuilding takes place during battles. Play cards which let you collect Runner Points and use them to instruct your pet (the Runner) to retrieve cards from a custom card pool. This adds another strategic level to combat as you balance offensive and defensive cards while building a stronger deck.

Varied gameplay loop

Complete missions, battle enemies, and encounter various events. Progress by gathering resources, recruiting survivors, and befriending wildlife. Return to your camp and use the collected resources to upgrade buildings, recycle unwanted cards, and create new cards for your deck.

Build your camp



Spend your resources to expand your camp with new buildings to unlock more cards and other useful things. Upgrade buildings and increase your chances of surviving the next mission. Trust us, you will need it.

name: Kind Nature Demo
short_description: Kind Nature is a post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilding game. As one of the last survivors in a harsh world, you'll embark on dangerous missions to gather resources, fight enemies, and expand your camp. In this shattered world, will you find a place to call home?
